description: The German Federal Waterways and Shipping Administration (WSV) produced PEGELONLINE, run by ITZBund, which publishes daily raw data on water levels and other hydrological parameters from inland and coastal gauges on the federal waterways, and since 2026 also forecasts. Coverage is the federal waterways of Germany; gauges of the Länder are not included. The data are free through a REST API, a HyDAS API in beta, XML, OGC WMS, WFS and SOS services and MQTT, covering up to 30 days back, and raw water levels and discharges from 1 January 2000 can be downloaded. Caveats: all values are unchecked raw data without warranty, and checked or older data must be requested from the operators or the Federal Institute of Hydrology. Simulation uses: live water levels for flood and low-water warning, emergency response and digital twins of waterways. Related records: Rijkswaterstaat water data (data-rijkswaterstaat-waterinfo-waterwebservices).
